output.title: ACME certificate profiles support added for CA flexibility
output.content: This adds support for ACME certificate profiles per IETF draft, allowing selection of different certificate categories (e.g., Let's Encrypt tlsserver, shortlived). The environment uses cert-manager with Certificate resources. If ACME-based certificate issuance is configured, certificate profiles enable more granular control over certificate characteristics and provide access to provider-specific offerings.
